purpose: 观察含原始 0xFF 的动作所留下的真实允许决策、完整解释、历史策略版本及离线一致性。
command: go run ./cmd/darksafe review --archive ledger.audit --org acme --seq 2 --end-seq 4 --fingerprint "$(cat ledger.fingerprint)"
output:
target sequence: 2
original decision:
  allowed: true
  reason: "matched allow policy"
  matched policies: ["p-ledger-read"]
  policy version: 1
recomputed decision:
  allowed: true
  reason: "matched allow policy"
  matched policies: ["p-ledger-read"]
  policy version: 1
consistent: yes

purpose: 观察仅动作字节改为 0xFE 后的真实拒绝决策，对照自身命中策略及离线一致性。
command: go run ./cmd/darksafe review --archive ledger.audit --org acme --seq 3 --end-seq 4 --fingerprint "$(cat ledger.fingerprint)"
output:
target sequence: 3
original decision:
  allowed: false
  reason: "matched deny policy"
  matched policies: ["p-ledger-change"]
  policy version: 1
recomputed decision:
  allowed: false
  reason: "matched deny policy"
  matched policies: ["p-ledger-change"]
  policy version: 1
consistent: yes
